title: Roles document (I4)
description: The Roles an org compiles from its records system's dated dump, loaded whole into the private store by `npm run house:roles -- load` (on stdin, never a file). It holds email keys (HMAC-SHA256 of an address under the deployment's pepper), never addresses.

roles_version.description: The date of the dump the Roles were compiled from (YYYY-MM-DD).

name.description: The name the Hub shows for the person.

email_keys.description: I3 keys of the addresses on record: lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256.

roles.description: I2 Role names. Empty: the person signs in to their Profile only.

nodes.description: The slugs of the nodes the person belongs to or leads.
